packages.name: @ismail-elkorchi/textfacts
packages.scope: Deterministic single-text kernel. Legacy broad public subpaths are frozen; new cross-package growth does not land here.
limitations: New cross-package protocol/resource/schema/tooling growth is frozen outside textfacts
Locale tailoring breadth remains limited

packages.name: @ismail-elkorchi/textdoc
packages.scope: Document containers, lifecycle, provenance, annotation-layer validation, and fixture-level graph annotation conventions are implemented.
limitations: Graph conventions are slice-proven for committed fixtures only; broad relation extraction, coreference resolution, entity linking, and parser behavior are not production-grade yet
Package remains private until broader release gates pass

packages.name: @ismail-elkorchi/textpack
packages.scope: Manifest validation, licensed English/French fixture resources, deterministic registry queries, fixture content loading, overlay precedence, and conflict diagnostics are implemented.
limitations: No public resource marketplace or vetting workflow is implemented
Package remains private until broader release gates pass

packages.name: @ismail-elkorchi/textrules
packages.scope: Reusable lexical token-pattern primitives are implemented; rule-backed POS, lemma, morphology, NER, dependency parsing, relation extraction, and coreference behavior is implemented only for frozen slices.
limitations: Behavior is limited to curated fixtures, frozen repository-authored slices, and small hand-authored resources
Package remains private until broader release gates pass

packages.name: @ismail-elkorchi/textpipeline
packages.scope: The deterministic processor contract includes synchronous, asynchronous, batch, stream, cancellation, caller-provided cache-hit tracing, and continue-on-error execution hooks.
limitations: No remote orchestration, distributed scheduling, durable cache storage, or worker pool execution
Package remains private until broader release gates pass

packages.name: @ismail-elkorchi/textcorpus
packages.scope: Explicit-token corpus collections, metadata slicing, deterministic fingerprint indexing, frozen-scope TF-IDF/BM25 scoring, and frozen-scope retrieval with query operators, metadata filters, qrels evaluation, deterministic size thresholds, and index JSON round-trips are implemented.
limitations: No streaming retrieval, durable index storage, external relevance benchmark, broad field weighting, or broad multilingual retrieval fixture set
Package remains private until broader release gates pass

packages.name: @ismail-elkorchi/textprotocol
packages.scope: Result-envelope types, runtime guards, repository schema, supported-version negotiation, and deterministic JSON transport wrapper are implemented.
limitations: Only result-envelope schema version 1 and the package JSON transport wrapper are standardized
Package remains private until broader release gates pass

packages.name: @ismail-elkorchi/textconformance
packages.scope: Machine-readable conformance reports, runtime guards, report diffs, claim-registry traceability checks, and synchronous runner are implemented.
limitations: No benchmark runner or release-oriented report renderer is implemented
Package remains private until broader release gates pass

packages.name: @ismail-elkorchi/textlab
packages.scope: Support-status, task-evidence, conformance-report, annotation, evidence-replay, and corpus-fixture inspection APIs and CLI commands are implemented for repository evidence files.
limitations: No comparator execution engine, interactive UI, or large-corpus browser is implemented
Package remains private until broader release gates pass

tasks.scope: Frozen fixtures, expected outputs, comparator captures, and executable behavior are present for the current slices.
evidence: comparator captures and explicit not-run gap records
limitations: Not a broad multilingual tokenizer benchmark suite
Newer script-family fixtures with not-run comparator entries are expected-output evidence, not comparator-backed evidence

tasks.scope: The document model, invalid-reference policy, lifecycle/provenance support, fixture-level graph annotation conventions, and round-trip validation are implemented.
limitations: Graph conventions are slice-proven for committed fixtures only; broad relation extraction, coreference resolution, entity linking, parser behavior, and confidence/loss conventions remain future work

tasks.scope: Resource-manifest validation, licensed fixtures, deterministic registry queries, fixture content loading, and overlay-conflict policy are implemented.
limitations: No public resource review workflow or broad resource marketplace is implemented

tasks.scope: Deterministic POS, lemma, and morphology outputs exist only for the frozen issue #10 slices.
limitations: No JavaScript comparator-backed POS/morph/lemma claim is made
Not a trained or broad multilingual tagger; fixture-bound deterministic behavior only

tasks.scope: Deterministic rule-backed PER/ORG/LOC outputs exist only for the frozen issue #13 slices, with recorded expected outputs and comparator captures.
limitations: Only PER/ORG/LOC and small curated resources are covered

tasks.scope: Deterministic raw TF, smooth TF-IDF, and Okapi BM25 outputs exist only for the frozen issue #14 explicit-token corpus.
limitations: No large-corpus relevance benchmark, fielded weighting, or performance proof

tasks.scope: Deterministic query parsing, required/prohibited operators, metadata field filters, inverted-index lookup, BM25 ranking, fielded BM25F ranking, snippets, explain output, qrels evaluation, relevance judgments, licensed fixture thresholds, and index JSON round-trips exist only for committed retrieval fixtures and bounded package tests.
limitations: No streaming retrieval, filesystem-backed index store, external relevance benchmark, or broad multilingual retrieval fixture set is implemented
Behavior uses explicit tokens from committed retrieval fixtures plus bounded package-level tests

tasks.scope: CoNLL-U/UD import-export round-trip behavior exists only for the frozen repository-authored fixtures; no dependency parser or broad UD treebank behavior is implemented.
limitations: CoNLL-U round-trip artifacts do not implement dependency parser behavior
No broad UD treebank or language coverage is claimed

tasks.scope: Deterministic dependency arcs are implemented only for the frozen en-basic, es-mwt, and ar-nonlatin slices.
limitations: Behavior is limited to deterministic rules for three frozen slices
No trained parser, broad UD treebank support, or JavaScript parser comparator is implemented
JavaScript parser comparison remains a gap/capability record
The UD validator capture is fixture-format evidence, not parser model-output evidence

tasks.scope: Deterministic typed relation outputs exist only for the frozen relation extraction corpus slice.
limitations: External comparator-backed and broad-corpus relation extraction support are not claimed
Behavior is limited to the repository-authored frozen corpus slice

tasks.scope: Coreference mention and chain behavior is implemented for the frozen repository-authored corpus slice only.
limitations: External comparator-backed and broad-corpus coreference support are not claimed
Behavior is limited to the repository-authored frozen corpus slice
